slots.name: FY2009 federal funding
slots.sentence: According to these Crosscut reports, Tribes, Native communities, and Native American people received $24.1 billion in inflation-adjusted federal funding in FY 2009.

slots.name: FY2020 federal funding
slots.sentence: Indeed, in FY 2020, inflation-adjusted total funding for Indian Country was just over $28.6 billion, which was 11.6% higher than 2010 levels.

slots.name: FY2024 funding growth
slots.sentence: However, between FY 2023 and FY 2024, Indian Country spending saw another substantial increase, growing by 33% year-over-year.

slots.name: funding gap
slots.sentence: BIA found a funding gap of just over $3 billion in FY 2021.

slots.name: IHS funding needs
slots.sentence: For context, the NTBFWG’s most recent budget request estimated total IHS funding needs at $73 billion—over 10 times more than the FY 2024 enacted IHS budget of $7.1 billion.
